notes: Batteries are user-replaceable behind the front panel.

gaps: It does not say which board each part is on.
No battery voltage, Ah or cartridge number was found for this model in any readable source.
method: One Aug 2024 EEVblog repair thread on a 7-year-old unit (E21 fault) names its MOSFETs, battery charging PSU, fuses, main transformer and relays.
CyberPower's 2019 battery-replacement instructions (read as text from the PDF, checked 2026-11-11) list CP1500AVRLCD in one shared procedure.

comps.spec: Replacement batteries (plural) in a battery pack, user-replaceable after removing the front panel cover; the instructions say to charge the unit for 4-8 hours afterwards; voltage and Ah not stated
Battery charging PSU, VIPer22A based; post says functional
8 MOSFETs, originals SinoPower SM6002N; several visibly blown or charred; the author replaced them with STMicro STP130N6F7 (listed as N-channel, 60 V, 80 A)
High current fuses, not blown at time of repair; ratings not stated
Main transformer, checked for shorts with no issues; core type and ratings not stated
4 relays (4 pcs), tested with SPDT contacts per the post

sources.title: EEVblog repair thread: CP1500AVRLCD E21 error repair (Aug 2024)
